styleAnswer.evidence: The tent is small, but both tarp planes carry several teal steps (highlight, light, mid, dark, deep), with patch variation, fold lines and tinted edges. Measured facts back this up: 14 visible tones per tile against 12 and 10 for the references, 0% near-flat coverage, and 0% neutral dark edge pixels, so the outlines lean dark teal or brown rather than black. The crate, poles and guy ropes use separate wood tones, so nothing reads as a flat sticker fill. It has fewer total colours (25) than the references and its texture is less fine-grained than the roof-tile scallops, but at this scale a careful artist would accept it beside them.
